capabilities: Detect lists with key-value pairs and format them automatically
Align key and value columns with a fixed key width
Apply alternating background colors to rows
Configure delimiter, alignment markers and appearance in settings
Enable or disable formatting per file via cssclasses
disambiguation: Not a data or properties tool; it only re-renders ordinary Markdown list rows that contain a delimiter as aligned key-value tables.
extras: Lists are ignored unless every item at every nesting level contains a key-value pair; Source mode shows plain Markdown without formatting.
problem: Obsidian renders plain lists with no column alignment or row separation, so lists of attribute pairs are hard to scan.
summary: Formats Markdown lists whose rows contain a delimiter as aligned, striped key-value tables in Live Preview and Reading view.
